application.name: Fiducial Detection
application.description: Renders synthetic scenes of ArUco markers and of a ChArUco board, detects them with holoscan-fiducials' ArucoDetectorOp and CharucoDetectorOp on every backend, checks each marker, chessboard corner and pose against ground truth, and shows the first detector's results on a HoloViz display. Also runs on a V4L2 camera.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-fiducials demo, with synthetic ArUco and ChArUco sources checked against ground truth, a V4L2 camera source and a HoloViz overlay.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: V4L2 camera
hardware.description: A camera offering YUYV, for the camera mode only.

synthetic.description: Detect markers and a ChArUco board in rendered scenes with every backend and with the one auto picks, check them against ground truth, and display the markers' detections when a display is available.

camera.description: Detect a 5x7 DICT_4X4_50 ChArUco board (4 cm squares, 3 cm markers) in a live V4L2 camera on the GPU, and display it. Local only: CI does not run it.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic frames of six markers and 30 of a ChArUco board through every backend and auto, every marker, chessboard corner and pose verified against ground truth; on a CI runner, auto must pick cuda.
